description: This file defines the CreateThingStrategy class, a strategy pattern implementation for handling create operations of 'Thing' entities in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes logic for validation, version handling, ACL permissions, and event generation related to creating new 'Thing' instances.
external_methods: Result validateThing(Context<ThingId> context, JsonSchemaVersion version, Thing thing, CreateThing command)
Result newMutationResult(CreateThing command, ThingCreated thingCreated, WithDittoHeaders<?> response, boolean flag1, boolean flag2)

classes.name: CreateThingStrategy
classes.description: A singleton class implementing the strategy for handling creation of 'Thing' entities, providing validation, version handling, ACL management, and event creation for the create operation.

methods.name: CreateThingStrategy.getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of CreateThingStrategy.

methods.name: CreateThingStrategy.isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the create command is well-defined and should be processed.

methods.name: CreateThingStrategy.doApply
methods.description: Performs the creation of a new 'Thing', including validation, version handling, and event generation.

methods.name: CreateThingStrategy.previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' (if any).

methods.name: CreateThingStrategy.nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the new 'Thing' that will result from this create command.
